1. (Currently Amended): A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path, wherein the device is \__configured to exert a radial force against tissue to facilitate expansion__; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

2. (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is __selected from the group consisting of__ an instrument and a medicament.

4. (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising __creating an opening in the cranium and inserting the elongated device through the opening or via a minimally invasive technique__.

5. (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain, wherein the device __is capable of maintaining a working channel while inserted__. 

7. (Currently Amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue, wherein the device __is designed to prevent collapse of the path during the procedure__.

8. (Currently Amended): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is __selected from the group consisting of__ an instrument and a medicament.

10. (Currently Amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers, wherein __the insertion is performed using a minimally invasive technique__. 

13. (Currently Amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; and introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue, wherein __the first expandable body is configured to reduce friction between the device and the tissue during insertion__.

14. (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is __selected from the group consisting of__ an instrument and a medicament. 

16. (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers, wherein __the insertion technique is minimally invasive__.
